explanation_ka:
**First Conditional** (პირველი კონდიციონალი) - real possibilities (რეალური შესაძლებლობები) მომავალში.

**Structure (სტრუქტურა):** If + present simple, will + base verb

✅ If it rains, I will stay home
✅ I will call you if I'm late

**🔥 მნიშვნელოვანი წესი:**
❌ If it will rain... (NO 'will' after 'if'!)
✅ If it rains...

**If clause** (if-ის ნაწილი) ყოველთვის **present simple**-ში!
**Main clause** (მთავარი ნაწილი) ყოველთვის **will** + base verb!

**მაგალითები:**
• If you study, you will pass (თუ ისწავლი, ჩააბარებ)
• If she comes, we will start (თუ მოვა, დავიწყებთ)
• If they ask, I will help (თუ სთხოვენ, დავეხმარები)

**Negative forms:**
• If you don't study, you won't pass
• If it doesn't rain, we'll go out

**Remember:** ქართულში ორივე ნაწილი "მო" ზმნით შეიძლება, მაგრამ ინგლისურში if-ის შემდეგ მხოლოდ present!

examples.en: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
I will call you if I finish early.
If she doesn't hurry, she will miss the bus.
We will go to the beach if the weather is nice.
examples.ka: სანაპიროზე წავალთ, თუ ამინდი კარგი იქნება.

common_mistakes_ka:
ქართველი სტუდენტების ყველაზე ხშირი შეცდომა არის "will"-ის გამოყენება if-ის ნაწილში: "If I will go..." — ეს არასწორია! სწორია: "If I go..."

ასევე ხშირად ავიწყდებათ, რომ if-ის ნაწილში მესამე პირთან "-s" დაბოლოება სჭირდება: "If she come..." — არასწორი! სწორია: "If she comes..."

ქართულში პირობითი წინადადებები ორივე ნაწილში მომავალ დროში შეიძლება იყოს, მაგრამ ინგლისურში if-ის ნაწილი ყოველთვის აწმყო დროშია.

exercises.question: If it ___ (rain), we will stay home.
She will be angry if you ___ (not/call) her.
If I ___ (have) time, I will help you.
Which is correct?
options: If it will snow, we will stay home.
If it snows, we will stay home.
If it snowed, we will stay home.
exercises.answer: If it snows, we will stay home.

exercises.question: We ___ (go) to the park if the sun shines.
If he ___ (not/hurry), he will be late.
They will come if you ___ (invite) them.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: I will buy it if I will have money.
I will buy it if I have money.
I buy it if I will have money.
exercises.answer: I will buy it if I have money.

exercises.question: If she ___ (pass) the test, her parents will be proud.
რომელია სწორი?
options: If I will go there, I will tell you.
If I go there, I will tell you.
If I went there, I will tell you.
exercises.answer: If I go there, I will tell you.

exercises.question: If you ___ (eat) too much, you will feel sick.
I ___ (be) surprised if she comes.
If we ___ (leave) now, we won't be late.
If the weather ___ (be) good, we will go hiking.
They ___ (miss) the train if they don't hurry.
If I ___ (find) your book, I will give it to you.
რომელია სწორი third person-თან?
options: If she come, I will be happy.
If she comes, I will be happy.
If she will come, I will be happy.
exercises.answer: If she comes, I will be happy.

exercises.question: If the price ___ (go) down, more people will buy it.
We ___ (not/go) if it rains heavily.
Which is correct?
options: If I will see him, I will tell him.
If I see him, I will tell him.
If I saw him, I will tell him.
exercises.answer: If I see him, I will tell him.

exercises.question: If you ___ (work) hard, you will succeed.
She ___ (be) disappointed if you don't come.
რომელია სწორი negative form?
options: If it won't rain, we will go.
If it doesn't rain, we will go.
If it don't rain, we will go.
exercises.answer: If it doesn't rain, we will go.

exercises.question: If he ___ (not/study), he will fail the exam.
I ___ (call) the police if you don't leave.
Which shows a real possibility?
options: If I was rich, I would travel.
If I win the lottery, I will travel.
exercises.answer: If I win the lottery, I will travel.

exercises.question: If they ___ (ask) nicely, I will help them.
If you ___ (be) late again, the boss will be angry.
რომელია სწორი?
options: If the shop will be open, I will buy bread.
If the shop is open, I will buy bread.
If the shop was open, I will buy bread.
exercises.answer: If the shop is open, I will buy bread.
